summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the alliance between Shelomo and Hiram Melekh Tzor to secure the resources and expertise needed for the construction of the Bet HaMikdash. He explores the logistical scale of the project, including the draft of workers and the use of foreign labor, while highlighting the historical significance of the building as a milestone 480 years after the exodus from Egypt.
questions: Why did Shelomo need to form an alliance with Hiram Melekh Tzor?
What is the significance of the 480-year timeline mentioned in relation to the exodus?
How does the labor force for the Bet HaMikdash compare to the construction of the Mishkan?
Why were metal tools forbidden at the site of the Bet HaMikdash?
What was the role of the gerim in the construction project?
